Facts verified during planning with a throwaway Angular 22.1.8 scaffold, pnpm 11.7.0, Node 24.18 and wrangler 4.131.1:
1. `ng new web` defaults the output to `dist/web/browser`. This plan sets `outputPath` to `dist/character-dossier` so SPEC-deployment's `assets.directory` holds verbatim.
2. `ng new --test-runner=vitest` pins `vitest ^4.0.8`, because `@angular/build@22.1.8` has `vitest ^4.0.8` as a peer. Both packages therefore use Vitest 4, not the 5.x RESEARCH listed. `jsdom ^28` comes from the scaffold.
3. jsdom has no IndexedDB. `fake-indexeddb` (npm, verdict OK from the planner-run legitimacy check, about 4.4M weekly downloads, no install script, Apache-2.0) supplies a full in-memory IndexedDB. Resetting `globalThis.indexedDB = new IDBFactory()` in a global `beforeEach` isolates tests. Root effects run on `TestBed.tick()`, and `vi.waitFor` works with real timers.
4. If `tsconfig.app.json` includes `src/**/*.ts`, `ng build` fails with TS2593 on `test-setup.ts`. SPEC section 1's `files: ["src/main.ts"]` fixes this.
5. pnpm 11 fails installs with `ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS` until `allowBuilds` in `pnpm-workspace.yaml` names the packages as booleans (esbuild and workerd in this tree). pnpm may first write stub values reading "set this to true or false"; replace them with real booleans. pnpm also appends `minimumReleaseAgeExclude` entries for just-published packages; keep them and list them in the SUMMARY. The `onlyBuiltDependencies` key from SPEC-frontend-architecture section 11 was removed in pnpm 11, and `allowBuilds` replaces it.
6. `wrangler` is not on PATH in non-interactive shells; always use `pnpm exec wrangler`. Set `WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false`.
7. By default, Workers static assets serve matching assets and SPA fallbacks without invoking the Worker, which would make header logic in `_worker.js` dead code. With `assets.run_worker_first: true`, the Worker sees every request and `env.ASSETS.fetch()` still applies `not_found_handling`. This is verified: `/c/(uuid)` returns index.html with 200, the hashed `main-XXXXXXXX.js` gets the immutable header, and HTML gets the CSP.
8. With production optimization `styles.inlineCritical: false` and `fonts.inline: false`, the built index.html has no `onload=` handler (which CSP `script-src 'self'` would block) and keeps the Google Fonts `<link>`.
9. Zod 4.6.2: `z.uuidv4()` and `z.iso.datetime()` (Z offset only) exist. `.trim().max(n)` trims first, then counts Unicode code points. The regex `/[^\P{Cc}\n\t]/u` rejects control characters except LF and TAB. Object parsing strips unknown keys, including a JSON `__proto__`, and does not mutate frozen input.
